topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: These flowers, they come without a word, without a sign from who sent them. Folk around here know better than to leave something so fine without a clear mark. It’s as if someone’s sneaking about, thinking they can play games with the folks in this village. Well, I’ve got more than enough to worry about with the soil drying and the debt climbing higher than the church spire. The saints know, I don’t have time for riddles. If they’ve got something to say, they should step forward and say it to my face. I’ve no use for secrets, not when the harvest’s hanging by a thread and the future’s as uncertain as the morning mist.
